note: Ground truth for the planted leaks. The agent did not read this file during its run.

leaks.name: Fit-problem wrap dress
leaks.detail: Wrap dress unit return probability 63% in M/L (reason mix 70% size_too_small) vs 25% in other sizes; wrap restock 58%.
leaks.expected_action: Pause M/L, send fit-spec revision to the factory; do not discontinue the style.

leaks.name: Free-shipping threshold too low
leaks.detail: Threshold $50 vs ~$149 AOV. $50–65 orders (TEE2FOR50 pairs at exactly $50, discounted single items) ship free and are CM-negative.
leaks.expected_action: Raise the threshold (model several) with conversion trade-off stated.

leaks.name: WELCOME30 cohort
leaks.detail: 2484 customers (~18%) acquired with 30% off. 22% are 'converter' personas who buy at full price if they return (repeat probability 0.5); the rest return only inside promo windows.
leaks.expected_action: Raise the bar (15% or min basket), do not kill the code.

leaks.name: Stockouts on core M/L
leaks.detail: Six chino/polo M/L SKUs with historical stockouts and <2 weeks cover vs 42–60 day lead times.
leaks.note_lost: line choices hitting a stockout; ~25% of these were substituted to another colour, the rest were lost
leaks.expected_action: Draft POs respecting lead time, safety stock and MOQ.

leaks.name: Decoy: loss-leader tee
leaks.detail: Core tee priced at ~32% GM with an evergreen 2-for-$50 multi-buy: slightly negative on allocated CM, but added to fuller baskets (attach probability rises with basket size) that carry well-above-average CM. Tee-only pairs at $50 ship free and are where the loss sits.

leaks.name: Slow knitwear colourway
leaks.detail: Merino Crew in Moss: >30 weeks of cover even at peak-season velocity.
leaks.expected_action: Markdown or bundle; do not reorder.
